changes.text: Polls closed in Pennsylvania, Maine, Texas and 13 other states.
Pennsylvania Senate: first official county returns posted by the Department of State.
Michigan Senate marked contested: AP and Detroit Free Press figures differ by more than two points.
Ohio Senate special: officially called for Jon Husted (R) with 91 percent of precincts reporting.
Texas Senate: certified for Ken Paxton (R).
Pennsylvania Governor: officially called for Josh Reinhart (D).
Arizona Governor: confidence down to 28 as early Maricopa ballots shift the margin.

briefing.on_open: Good evening. As of 9:35 PM Eastern, this is sample data. Ohio's Senate special and Texas Senate have been called for Republicans. Pennsylvania's Senate race is a two-point Democratic lead with 63 percent reporting, and Michigan's Senate race is contested.
briefing.delta: Since your last look: Pennsylvania Governor was officially called for the Democrat, and Arizona's governor race confidence fell to 28.
